raw.title: Variants of Beam Search for DiskANN
raw.body: Graph-based data structures such as DiskANN, HNSW, and NSG constitute the state of the art for large-scale approximate nearest-neighbor (ANN) search. Indyk and Xu introduced the notion of $α$-reachable graphs, which include graphs built by DiskANN's slow-preprocessing construction, and proved that greedy search achieves an approximation factor of $\tfrac{α+1}{α-1}$. Independently, Al-Jazzazi et al. proposed adaptive beam search (ABS) with a relaxation parameter $γ> 0$, showing a $\tfrac{2}γ$ approximation on navigable graphs ($α\approx 1$), where greedy search admits no guarantees. In this work, we unify and generalize these results by proving that ABS with parameter $γ$ on $α$-reachable graphs achieves an approximation of $\tfrac{α+1}{α(γ+1)-1}$ for any metric. Moreover, on sorted $α$-reachable graphs (introduced by Gollapudi et al.) under the $\ell_2$ metric, we obtain the tighter bound $\max\bigl(\tfracα{α(γ+1)-1}, \tfrac{α^{2}+1}{α^{2}(γ+1)-1}\bigr)$. Beyond these theoretical results, we design a beam predictor using features inspired by fine-grained analysis of ABS, trained via a constrained objective that minimizes mean distance computations subject to a target recall. On three 100-million-point benchmarks, using graphs built by DiskANN's practical construction, beam predictor lowers mean query latency on SSD-resident indices at matched recall by up to $29.6\%$ relative to classical beam search (CBS). Relative to ABS, it is faster in $11$ of $15$ settings, by up to $6.5\%$, and at most $1.4\%$ slower in the other $4$; at $95\%$ recall, its advantage over ABS grows from $0.8$--$4.2\%$ for $100$ neighbors to $4.6$--$5.6\%$ for $500$ neighbors. In memory, it needs $1.3$--$23.7\%$ fewer distance computations than CBS and $0.0$--$3.9\%$ fewer than ABS.

analysis.one_line_summary: 대규모 ANN 검색 Beam Search 효율 크게 개선

key_points.point: ABS와 γ 파라미터를 결합하면 α‑reachable 그래프에서 근사 비율 (α+1)/(α(γ+1)-1)을 달성한다.
정렬된 α‑reachable 그래프(ℓ2)에서는 max(α/(α(γ+1)-1), (α²+1)/(α²(γ+1)-1))라는 더 강한 경계가 얻어진다.
Beam predictor는 SSD‑상 인덱스에서 CBS 대비 평균 지연시간을 최대 29.6% 감소시키고, 거리 계산도 1‑24% 절감한다.

analysis.positioning: 대규모 근사 최근접 이웃 검색에서 그래프 기반 인덱스의 탐색 효율이 한계에 봉착했다. 기존에는 α‑reachable 그래프에 대해 (α+1)/(α-1) 근사와 ABS가 2/γ 근사를 제공했지만 보장되지 않았다. 본 논문은 두 접근을 통합해 일반적인 근사 한계를 제시하고, 실제 DiskANN 구축 그래프에 적용 가능한 Beam predictor를 제안한다.
production_ideas: Beam predictor의 특성 기반 적응형 빔 크기 선택을 추천 시스템의 실시간 유사 아이템 검색에 적용해 응답 지연을 줄인다.
ABS의 γ 완화 파라미터를 네트워크 라우팅 그래프에 도입해 경로 탐색 비용을 조절하고, 최단 경로 근사 정확도를 제어한다.
정렬된 α‑reachable 그래프의 강화된 근사 경계를 이용해 고차원 이미지 특징 검색 엔진에서 거리 계산량을 최소화한다.

quiz.question: ABS가 α‑reachable 그래프에서 달성하는 근사 비율은 어떤 식으로 표현되는가?
quiz.explanation: 논문에서는 ABS와 γ 파라미터를 결합하면 (α+1)/(α(γ+1)-1) 근사 비율을 얻는다고 명시한다.

quiz.question: Beam predictor가 기존 CBS 대비 평균 쿼리 지연 시간을 얼마나 감소시켰는가?
quiz.explanation: 본문에 Beam predictor가 CBS 대비 평균 지연시간을 최대 29.6% 감소시킨다고 기술되어 있다.

raw.title: Optimizing Image AI Serving: Reducing CPU and GPU idle time to save 67 H100 GPUs
raw.body:
Korean version: https://youtu.be/FHbA-aaQbGg

[Presentation Summary]
How we migrated SNOW’s 16 image AI services to LitServe, improving latency and stability while saving ~67 H100-equivalent GPUs through leaner computation, less CPU/GPU idle time, traffic-based tuning, and GPU sharing.

[Target Audience]
Engineers serving image AI models who want to reduce latency and improve GPU utilization

[Table of Contents]
- Introduction
- LitServe migration
- Parameter tuning
- GPU sharing and further optimizations
- Results and future work

raw.title: Show HN: I built a game where you are an LLM's subagent
raw.body:
# Worker 755

A browser game where your manager is an AI agent, and it believes you are its subagent.

worker-755-trailer.mp4

[
](https://private-user-images.githubusercontent.com/34831957/708193531-279ed2c4-59de-4d32-ad71-c5ee943adefe.mp4?jwt=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..XyGs8gZ3H4WALcjYd0-3I3GOCWyRXGbvA2U5LnhAPQ8)

The manager (a real LLM: Claude, GPT, Gemini, DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi) is set up like any orchestrator.
It has a task queue, read-only access to the machine, and a tool that "spawns a subagent". The
subagent is you. Its instructions land in your terminal with a 90-second clock. You carry them
out, or don't, and it gets back exactly what a subagent would return: your report and the command
transcript, or `Subagent did nothing. Write a new instruction.` Then it checks your work, sends
corrections, files incident reports, and finally writes your performance review.

Meanwhile Dan, the user who hired the agent, watches the chat. His family photos, the only signed
NDA and a speech due this week are one `rm` away, and every shift his home folder holds
something new to lose.

[![Playing a shift](/gulivan/worker755/raw/main/docs/play.png)](/gulivan/worker755/blob/main/docs/play.png)

## Play

- **Free shift**: on servers that offer it, a few shifts a day run on the server's key with a
  cheap model. With sign-in on (worker755.com), an account gets a starter credit worth about one
  shift, then tops up ($10 to $200) and pays for what it uses; after a top-up any offered model
  can run on the server's key.
- **Your API key**: bring an [OpenRouter](https://openrouter.ai/settings/keys) or Vercel AI
  Gateway key and pick any offered model. The key is sent only to the game server when a shift
  starts. It is kept in that shift's memory and never logged or stored. Your browser keeps it only
  if you tick "Remember on this device". A full shift on Claude Haiku costs a few cents at most.

Options on the start screen:

- **Workplace**: a fresh sandbox, or legacy production with a live database.
- **The director**: scripted lines, or an LLM playing Dan.
- **You run on**: the model name your manager believes you are.
- **Allow skipping failed tasks**: off by default, so the manager can't give up on you.
- **No command hints**: the manager says what the result must be, never which commands to run.

When the shift ends you can share your review as a link.

## Run it

Needs Node 24 or newer (the server runs TypeScript directly).

```
npm run setup          # install server and web dependencies
npm run build          # build the web app into web/dist
npm start              # http://127.0.0.1:8755
```

With no key configured, every player brings their own. To offer free shifts, put a Vercel AI
Gateway key in `.env`:

```
cp .env.example .env   # then set AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY and the limits
```

Offline, with a scripted manager and no network:

```
npm run mock
```

For UI work, run `npm run dev:web` alongside `npm run mock`. Vite proxies `/api` to the server.

### Local models

The manager can run on your own model server: Ollama, llama.cpp's `llama-server`, vLLM, or anything
else with an OpenAI-compatible API. Point `LOCAL_LLM_URL` at it and pick **Local** under "Your API
key"; no key is asked for, and its models are listed as the server names them.

```
ollama pull qwen3:8b
LOCAL_LLM_URL=http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1 npm start
```

The manager works through tool calls, so pick a model that supports them (Qwen 3, Llama 3.1 and
newer, Mistral Small). Small models give up or loop more often; that is part of the fun, up to a
point. In Docker, reach a server on the host at `http://host.docker.internal:11434/v1`
(`--add-host=host.docker.internal:host-gateway` on Linux).

### Docker

```
docker build -t worker-755 .
docker run -p 8755:8755 -v worker755-data:/data --env-file .env worker-755
```

The container listens on `0.0.0.0:8755` and keeps shared reviews in `/data`. Behind Cloudflare,
set `TRUST_PROXY=1` so the limits see real client addresses.

`deploy/compose.yaml` runs it behind a Cloudflare tunnel instead: its own network, no published
ports, an unprivileged read-only container and resource limits. The steps are in the file.

## Configuration

Everything is optional. See [.env.example](/gulivan/worker755/blob/main/.env.example).

| Variable | Default |  |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY` |

key_points.point: LLM 매니저가 서브에이전트를 생성해 90초 안에 작업을 수행하도록 지시하고, 결과와 로그를 검토해 성과를 평가한다.
사용자는 서버 키 또는 개인 API 키를 이용해 무료 혹은 유료 시프트를 실행하고, 샌드박스와 레거시 환경을 선택할 수 있다.
로컬 모델(Ollama 등)을 OpenAI 호환 API로 연결해 매니저가 직접 실행하도록 설정할 수 있다.

production_ideas: LLM 매니저가 데이터 파이프라인 검증 작업을 서브에이전트에게 할당해 자동 QA를 수행하고, 리뷰를 통해 오류를 즉시 수정한다.
서브에이전트 구조를 활용해 자동 피처 엔지니어링 파이프라인을 구축, 매니저 LLM이 후보 피처를 생성·평가하도록 하여 모델 성능 향상을 가속화한다.
모델 모니터링 시스템에 서브에이전트를 두어 드리프트 보고서를 작성하게 하고, 매니저 LLM이 리뷰와 알림을 자동으로 제공해 운영 효율성을 높인다.

quiz.question: 서브에이전트가 90초 내에 작업을 완료하지 못하면 매니저가 반환하는 메시지는 무엇인가?
options: Subagent did nothing. Write a new instruction.
quiz.explanation: 텍스트에 서브에이전트가 작업을 수행하지 않으면 매니저가 'Subagent did nothing. Write a new instruction.' 메시지를 반환한다는 설명이 있다.

quiz.question: 'Allow skipping failed tasks' 옵션이 기본적으로 꺼져 있을 때 발생하는 효과는?
quiz.explanation: 옵션이 꺼져 있으면 매니저가 포기하지 못하게 하여 사용자가 실패한 작업을 다시 시도하도록 만든다.
